speaker: Facilitator
text: Good morning. What helps you keep saving each week?

speaker: Member A
text: The rule that you pay a small fine if you miss. It is small, but nobody likes paying it, and the others remind you.

speaker: Member B
text: I save because I have a goal. I want to buy a goat before the rains.

speaker: Member C
text: I am a motorcycle taxi driver. Some weeks are good, some weeks the roads are flooded and there are no customers.

speaker: Member A
text: When the coffee price fell, many of us could not bring the full amount. The group agreed to reduce the amount for those months.

speaker: Member B
text: I bought chickens with my first loan and now I sell eggs every week in the market.

speaker: Member C
text: I repaired the motorcycle. Without it I have no income, so that was the only option.

speaker: Member D
text: Mine was for my brother's funeral. It was not planned, but the group understood.

speaker: Facilitator
text: Anything else you want to share about being in the group?

speaker: Member D
text: When my wife was sick, the members came and helped us with the field. That is something money cannot buy. [pause] I did not expect it.

speaker: Member A
text: We also share advice. Member B taught me how to vaccinate the chickens.
